-- ADR-0012: per-client Aimfox credentials live here, not in CS PDCA col_105.
select cs.api_key, cs.client_id::text as client_id, cs.external_workspace_id as workspace_id, c.name
from public.client_sequencers cs
join public.sequencers s on s.id = cs.sequencer_id and s.key = 'aimfox'
join public.clients    c on c.id = cs.client_id
where cs.enabled and coalesce(cs.api_key, '') <> ''
order by c.name;

with p as (select $1::jsonb as j),
src as (
  select (r->>'client_id')::uuid                as client_id,
         nullif(r->>'profile_id','')            as profile_id,
         (r->>'report_date')::date              as report_date,
         (r->>'invites_sent')::int              as invites_sent,
         (r->>'invites_accepted')::int          as invites_accepted,
         (r->>'invite_limit')::int              as invite_limit,
         (r->>'invite_limit_remaining')::int    as invite_limit_remaining,
         (r->>'remaining_database_size')::int   as remaining_database_size,
         (r->>'schedule_today')::int            as schedule_today,
         (r->>'schedule_tomorrow')::int         as schedule_tomorrow,
         (r->>'schedule_day_after')::int        as schedule_day_after
  from p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j) r
  where nullif(r->>'profile_id','') is not null
    and (r->>'invites_sent') is not null        -- never write a row we could not measure
)
, ins as (
  insert into public.sequencer_daily_stats (
    id, client_id, sequencer_id, profile_id, report_date,
    invites_sent, invites_accepted, invite_limit, invite_limit_remaining,
    remaining_database_size, schedule_today, schedule_tomorrow, schedule_day_after, created_at)
  select gen_random_uuid(), s.client_id,
         '00000000-0000-4000-a000-000000000003'::uuid,   -- sequencers.key = 'aimfox'
         s.profile_id, s.report_date,
         s.invites_sent, s.invites_accepted, s.invite_limit, s.invite_limit_remaining,
         s.remaining_database_size,
         coalesce(s.schedule_today, 0), coalesce(s.schedule_tomorrow, 0), coalesce(s.schedule_day_after, 0),
         now()
  from src s
  on conflict (client_id, sequencer_id, profile_id, report_date) do update set
    invites_sent            = excluded.invites_sent,
    invites_accepted        = excluded.invites_accepted,
    invite_limit            = excluded.invite_limit,
    invite_limit_remaining  = excluded.invite_limit_remaining,
    remaining_database_size = excluded.remaining_database_size,
    schedule_today          = excluded.schedule_today,
    schedule_tomorrow       = excluded.schedule_tomorrow,
    schedule_day_after      = excluded.schedule_day_after
  returning id, profile_id
)
select (select count(*) from src) as candidates,
       (select count(*) from ins) as written,
       (select string_agg(profile_id, ',') from ins) as profiles;
